Name: Jehoadah
Summary: Son of Ahaz and father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:36: Son of Ahaz and father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jehoadah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
